verified_facts.text: W Maldives is a private island resort in North Ari Atoll, set on a house reef.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the breathtaking North Ari Atoll, our Maldives private island resort is set atop one of the best house reefs in the Maldives

verified_facts.text: Overwater villas have their own private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dip and splash in your Maldives overwater villa with a pool exclusively for you

verified_facts.text: Each overwater bungalow has direct access to the house reef.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy direct access to one of the best house reefs from each of our Maldives overwater bungalows

verified_facts.text: The beach villas take their design cues from the island's mangroves and sit steps from the sand.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Maldives beach villas channel the raw beauty of the island’s lush mangroves

verified_facts.text: AWAY Spa has private overwater treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: our expert Maldives spa therapists bring the bliss in private treatment rooms above the turquoise blue.
